article.title: NFL EDGE Wednesday Evening Brief
article.dek: The Hit Rate card changed hands, Thursday's final injury report is out, and the Colts-Texans split is still telling the same story.

items.headline: The Hit Rate card changed hands — Jaguars moneyline is the new top pick
paragraphs: The board priced two games this evening that it could not price this morning: Jaguars at Giants and Steelers at Eagles. And the Jaguars did not just get priced — they took the Hit Rate card.

Hit Rate is now Jaguars moneyline at -260 on FanDuel for Sunday, 4:25 p.m. ET kickoff. The app's model gives Jacksonville about a 76% chance to win; the market says about 70%. The Bengals moneyline held the card this morning at -295. It is -280 at FanDuel tonight, and it is off the card.
Balanced is unchanged: Vikings +3 at +100 on FanDuel for Sunday night. The Value card is still empty — the app found no +EV price on the board this week.
items.takeaway: Hit Rate is now Jaguars moneyline -260. Balanced is still Vikings +3 at +100. Value is still empty.

sources.label: NFL EDGE app

items.headline: Thursday's final injury report: both teams are banged up, and the Colts lost both tackles
paragraphs: The final designations are in for Thursday night, 8:15 p.m. ET kickoff. The Colts ruled out five players: both starting tackles, Bernhard Raimann (concussion) and Jalen Travis (knee), plus cornerback Charvarius Ward (knee), tight end Will Mallory (hamstring), and defensive tackle Jerry Tillery (calf).
Cornerback Sauce Gardner (calf) is questionable. He did not practice at all this week, and he left Sunday's game with the injury and did not return.

The Texans ruled out four: defensive end Danielle Hunter (hamstring), wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring), running back Woody Marks (concussion), and tight end Brevin Jordan (foot/illness). The good news for Houston: running back David Montgomery is back after missing four games, with no injury designation.
items.takeaway: The Colts play Thursday without either starting tackle and maybe without Sauce Gardner. The Texans are without Hunter and Harrison Jr., but David Montgomery is back.

items.headline: Two Sunday quarterbacks are still in doubt — and the app has not caught up on one of them
paragraphs: Baker Mayfield did not practice Wednesday with his foot and thumb injuries. Head coach Todd Bowles said the team will decide on Friday whether he plays Sunday at Detroit, and ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports Mayfield is a long shot to play, with Jalon Daniels in line to start.
The app still lists Mayfield as Tampa Bay's expected starter. It has not picked up the reporting yet. Treat the Bucs line with care until Friday's call lands.

Geno Smith is the other one to watch, and here the app and the reporting agree. Smith was limited in Wednesday's walkthrough with an ankle injury and said starting Sunday at the Chargers is "the plan." The app lists him as the Jets' expected starter, questionable. If he cannot go, rookie Cade Klubnik starts.
items.takeaway: Mayfield is a long shot for Sunday and the app still shows him starting — wait for Friday's call. Geno Smith says he plans to play, and the app agrees.

items.headline: Weather: still mild, still a non-factor
paragraphs: Nothing changed since this morning. Thursday is under a roof in Houston. Sunday's outdoor games are mild — Buffalo is around 61 degrees with a chance of rain showers and wind about 8 mph, gusting to 18. No game this week has wind trouble.
Weather is a fact, not an edge. The app prices the games, not the forecast.

sections.title: What It Means for NFL EDGE

items.headline: How to read the new Hit Rate card
paragraphs: Hit Rate is the pick the app thinks is most likely to win. It forgoes value for win probability. The app's own tutorial says Hit Rate is not Profit Rate — a likely winner is not the same thing as a good price.

Jaguars moneyline -260 at FanDuel. At -260, every $2.60 you risk wins $1. The app's model gives Jacksonville about a 76% chance; the market says about 70%. The app's play-through is -269. That is the price where it stops being a bet, and -260 still clears it.

It is also the app's biggest stake of the week at 1.25 units. Balanced is Vikings +3 at +100 — even money, a good starting point if you are new to this. Value is empty because nothing on the board is +EV, and the app says so plainly instead of forcing one.
items.takeaway: Hit Rate is Jaguars moneyline -260: the most likely winner, not a value play. Balanced is Vikings +3 at +100. Value is empty because nothing is +EV.

items.headline: The app still thinks the big spreads are too fat — and it still did not bet any of them
paragraphs: The model's margins against the DraftKings spreads: Chiefs by about 6.3 against a 15.5-point spread. Bills by about 3.4 against 16.5. Texans by about 0.8 against 12.5. Bears by about 0.2 against 11.5. The gaps are big, and they are still there tonight.

None of those underdogs cleared the bar for a card. A gap is the start of the work, not the bet. If your book has a better number than the app's, tap Check, type in your book's line and price, and let the app run it back through the model and give you a bet or no-bet verdict on your price.
items.takeaway: Four double-digit spreads, four big model gaps, zero cards. The gap alone is not the bet — Check your price.

items.headline: The public is still on the Colts. The money is still on the Texans.
paragraphs: The split held all day. On the DraftKings spread, Colts +12.5 drew 62% of the bets but only 43% of the handle. Texans -12.5 drew 38% of the bets but 57% of the money. Most tickets on one side, most dollars on the other — that is the disagreement a Fade is built on.
The total and the moneyline do not disagree. Over 43.5 has 66% of the bets and 70% of the handle, and the moneyline splits line up too. This is a spread-only story.
The line backs the money side up. Houston opened at -10. It sits at -12.5 at DraftKings and -13 at Pinnacle. What it could mean: the bigger money likes Houston more than the crowd does.

What to watch: if the Colts keep taking tickets and the number drifts to +13 or +13.5, that is a better price on the side the public likes — but only if no new bad Colts news lands. If you like Houston, the price has already moved against you, so run it through Check now rather than hoping it comes back. This is context for your decision, not a pick. The app's cards are the picks.
items.takeaway: Most bets are on the Colts, most money is on the Texans, and the line keeps moving Houston's way. Use it as context, not a pick — and run your side through Check at your price.

items.headline: Houston's total dropped a point; the spread held
paragraphs: The Colts-Texans total was 44.5 this morning. It is 43.5 at DraftKings and FanDuel tonight, and 44.0 at Pinnacle. The spread did not move: Texans -12.5 at DraftKings and FanDuel, -13 at Pinnacle. The app caught the total move — its board shows 43.5.
If your book still has 44.5 and Check says bet, take it now. A good number today beats a hoped-for number tomorrow.
items.takeaway: Total down to 43.5 from 44.5. Spread steady at Texans -12.5, -13 at Pinnacle.

items.headline: Kansas City got cheaper, Cincinnati drifted, and the Chargers came down half a point
paragraphs: Chiefs -16.5 this morning, -15.5 at DraftKings tonight (-16 at Pinnacle). Bengals moneyline -295 at FanDuel this morning, -280 tonight — and that drift cost them the Hit Rate card. FanDuel moved the Bengals spread too, from -5.5 to -6.5. Chargers -3.5 this morning, -3.0 at DraftKings tonight.
And the two games the app could not price this morning now have lines: Jaguars -6 and Steelers -4.5 at DraftKings.
items.takeaway: Chiefs -15.5, Bengals moneyline -280, Chargers -3.0. Jaguars and Steelers are priced now.

items.headline: Thursday game? Thursday check.
paragraphs: Inactives land about 90 minutes before kickoff, and Sauce Gardner is the name to watch — questionable after missing every practice this week. Line up your number now and run it through Check at your price once inactives are out.
One more thing while you are here: settlement is manual. The tracker only works if you are honest with yourself. Log the losers too.
items.takeaway: Thursday game, Thursday check: wait for inactives about 90 minutes before kickoff, then run your price through Check. And log the losers too — the tracker only works if you are honest with it.
